## Introduction {#sec-apC-intro-en}

At the end of each chapter, a "Challenge" section proposes a small
exercise that applies, to the Contraponto Magazine project presented in
@sec-03-project-en, only the language tools already covered up to that
point in the book. This appendix gathers the starter file for each of
these challenges, with part of the code already written and the rest
marked with `TODO` comments, so that each student's job is to complete
and extend what is already there, instead of always starting from
scratch.

## Chapter 3 Challenge: Complete the Article Catalogue {#sec-apC-cap03-en}

Starter file for the challenge in @sec-03-challenge-en. The first two
articles are already complete, following the same format used in
@sec-03-arrays-en; the remaining points are left to complete.

```php
<?php
// Chapter 3 Challenge: complete the Contraponto article catalogue
//
// 1. Add more articles to $artigos, until you have at least five;
// 2. Show the title of the third article in the catalogue (index 2);
// 3. Build $categorias from $artigos, with no repeats, sorted
//    alphabetically;
// 4. Check, with in_array(), whether the category "Entrevistas" is
//    already represented in $categorias.

$artigos = array(
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Entrevista: o futuro do jornalismo local",
        "autor"     => "Rita Ferreira",
        "categoria" => "Tecnologia"
    ),
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Crítica: a nova exposição do museu",
        "autor"     => "Marco Antunes",
        "categoria" => "Cultura"
    ),

    // TODO 1: add more articles here, following the same format
);

// TODO 2: show the title of the third article (index 2)


// TODO 3: build $categorias from $artigos, with no repeats,
// and sort it alphabetically


// TODO 4: check with in_array() whether "Entrevistas" is already in $categorias
```

## Chapter 4 Challenge: List and Filter Articles {#sec-apC-cap04-en}

Starter file for the challenge in @sec-04-challenge-en. The `$artigos`
array, already complete here with five articles, continues the
catalogue from the previous challenge; the work for this chapter is to
iterate over it and filter it, not to build it again.

```php
<?php
// Chapter 4 Challenge: list and filter the Contraponto articles
//
// 1. Use a foreach to iterate over $artigos and show the title of
//    each one;
// 2. Inside the same foreach, also show the author, but only for
//    articles whose category is "Cultura";
// 3. Use an if so that the foreach only shows articles from the
//    category given in $categoria_escolhida.

// For now, simulate the category chosen by the reader
$categoria_escolhida = "Tecnologia";

$artigos = array(
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Entrevista: o futuro do jornalismo local",
        "autor"     => "Rita Ferreira",
        "categoria" => "Tecnologia"
    ),
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Crítica: a nova exposição do museu",
        "autor"     => "Marco Antunes",
        "categoria" => "Cultura"
    ),
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Como nasceu a Contraponto",
        "autor"     => "Rita Ferreira",
        "categoria" => "Cultura"
    ),
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Roteiro cultural de outubro",
        "autor"     => "Marco Antunes",
        "categoria" => "Música"
    ),
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Como a IA está a mudar o jornalismo",
        "autor"     => "Rita Ferreira",
        "categoria" => "Tecnologia"
    )
);

// TODO 1, 2 and 3: iterate over $artigos with foreach, showing the title of
// each one, the author only for articles of category "Cultura", and
// filtering by the value of $categoria_escolhida
```

## Chapter 7 Challenge: Real Requests with GET and POST {#sec-apC-cap07-en}

Starter file for the challenge in @sec-07-challenge-en. `header.php` and
`footer.php` appear here already complete, as they would be after
solving the previous challenge; `index.php` already has the
`formatarArtigo()` function complete, as solved in @sec-05-challenge-en,
and already includes the HTML comment form, missing only replacing the
fixed variable with the real value of `$_GET["categoria"]`, and
handling that form's submission.

```php
<!-- header.php -->
<header>
    <h1>Contraponto</h1>
    <nav>
        <a href="index.php">Início</a> |
        <a href="index.php?categoria=Cultura">Cultura</a> |
        <a href="index.php?categoria=Tecnologia">Tecnologia</a> |
        <a href="index.php?categoria=Música">Música</a>
    </nav>
</header>
```

```php
<!-- footer.php -->
<footer>
    <p>&copy; 2026 Revista Contraponto. Todos os direitos reservados.</p>
</footer>
```

```php
<!-- index.php -->
<?php
// Chapter 7 Challenge: real requests with $_GET and $_POST
//
// 1. Replace the $categoria_escolhida line with the real value of
//    $_GET["categoria"], with isset() handling the case where it
//    doesn't exist (in that case, show all articles);
// 2. Handle the submission of the comment form, already included
//    further below: check whether $_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] is
//    "POST" and, in that case, show a confirmation message with
//    $_POST["nome"] and $_POST["texto"].

function formatarArtigo($artigo) {
    return $artigo["titulo"] . " — por " . $artigo["autor"];
}

$artigos = array(
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Entrevista: o futuro do jornalismo local",
        "autor"     => "Rita Ferreira",
        "categoria" => "Tecnologia"
    ),
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Crítica: a nova exposição do museu",
        "autor"     => "Marco Antunes",
        "categoria" => "Cultura"
    ),
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Como nasceu a Contraponto",
        "autor"     => "Rita Ferreira",
        "categoria" => "Cultura"
    ),
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Roteiro cultural de outubro",
        "autor"     => "Marco Antunes",
        "categoria" => "Música"
    ),
    array(
        "titulo"    => "Como a IA está a mudar o jornalismo",
        "autor"     => "Rita Ferreira",
        "categoria" => "Tecnologia"
    )
);

// TODO 1: replace this line with reading $_GET["categoria"]
$categoria_escolhida = "Tecnologia";

require "header.php";

foreach ($artigos as $artigo) {
    if ($artigo["categoria"] === $categoria_escolhida) {
        echo "<p>" . formatarArtigo($artigo) . "</p>";
    }
}

// TODO 2: handle the submission of the comment form below, via POST
?>

<form action="index.php" method="POST">
    <label for="nome">Nome</label>
    <input id="nome" name="nome" type="text" />
    <label for="texto">Comentário</label>
    <textarea id="texto" name="texto"></textarea>
    <input type="submit" value="Comentar" />
</form>

<?php
require "footer.php";
```

## Chapter 8 Challenge: Migrate the Catalogue to a Database {#sec-apC-cap08-en}

Starter file for the challenge in @sec-08-challenge-en. `header.php` and
`footer.php` stay the same as in the previous chapters; `config.php`
already establishes the connection to MySQL, missing only creating the
database and the table; `seed.php` picks up the usual `$artigos`
catalogue, to migrate it, once, into the table; and `index.php` still
iterates over the in-memory array, as in the previous challenge, missing
only replacing that `foreach` with a database query.

```php
<!-- header.php -->
<header>
    <h1>Contraponto</h1>
    <nav>
        <a href="index.php">Início</a> |
        <a href="index.php?categoria=Cultura">Cultura</a> |
        <a href="index.php?categoria=Tecnologia">Tecnologia</a> |
        <a href="index.php?categoria=Música">Música</a>
    </nav>
</header>
```

```php
<!-- footer.php -->
<footer>
    <p>&copy; 2026 Revista Contraponto. Todos os direitos reservados.</p>
</footer>
```

```php
<!-- config.php -->
<?php
$conexao = new mysqli("localhost", "utilizador", "password", "contraponto");

if ($conexao->connect_error) {
    die("Ligação falhou: " . $conexao->connect_error);
}
```

```php

        "autor"     => "Rita Ferreira",
        "categoria" => "Tecnologia"
    )
);

require "header.php";

// TODO 3: replace this block with a query to the artigos table, with
// a prepared statement, filtering by $categoria_escolhida when it
// exists, and returning all articles when it doesn't
foreach ($artigos as $artigo) {
    if ($categoria_escolhida === null || $artigo["categoria"] === $categoria_escolhida) {
        echo "<p>" . $artigo["titulo"] . " — por " . $artigo["autor"] . "</p>";
    }
}

require "footer.php";
```
